boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Spelman observances that mark entry, Founders Week, and the transition from student to alumna.

cards.title: Wear white for Spelman’s ceremonial calendar
cards.subtitle: Induction, Founders Day, Class Day, Baccalaureate and Commencement
cards.notes: Review the College’s white-attire guidance before a ceremonial event; the required ensemble varies by class year and occasion.
cards.short_summary: White attire is a formal Spelman tradition used at key ceremonies.
cards.evidence_claim: Spelman describes white attire as a treasured tradition, requires it for Founders Day Convocation, and requires graduating seniors to wear it under regalia for several senior ceremonies.
cards.access_notes: Participation requirements and attire guidance are set by the College; consult the linked page before attending.

cards.title: Begin with the white-attire induction
cards.subtitle: New Student Orientation, Spelman College
cards.notes: First-year students should bring the required white attire for induction and follow orientation instructions for the ceremony.
cards.short_summary: New students enter the Spelman sisterhood in a white-attire induction ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: Spelman states that all first-year students are required to wear the traditional white ensemble for the New Student Orientation Induction Ceremony.
cards.access_notes: For incoming students; orientation logistics are communicated by Spelman.

cards.title: Gather for Founders Day Convocation
cards.subtitle: Founders Week, Spelman College
cards.notes: Follow the annual Founders Week schedule for Convocation details and arrive ready for a formal community observance.
cards.short_summary: The annual Convocation anchors Spelman’s Founders Day observance.
cards.evidence_claim: Spelman calls Founders Day a time-honored tradition and identifies Founders Day Convocation as the celebration’s central gathering.
cards.access_notes: Annual event dates and attendance details are published by Spelman.

cards.title: Mark Founders Day with Senior Class Robing
cards.subtitle: Founders Week, Spelman College
cards.notes: Seniors should check the Founders Week program for the morning robing schedule and College-issued participation guidance.
cards.short_summary: Senior Class Robing is a named Founders Week observance.
cards.evidence_claim: Spelman’s 2026 Founders Week listing includes Senior Class Robing on the morning of Founders Day.
cards.access_notes: For the senior class; verify the annual schedule with Spelman.

cards.entity_name: Spelman College Birthday Party and Cake Cutting
cards.title: Join the College birthday cake cutting
cards.subtitle: Founders Week, led by the Granddaughters Club
cards.notes: See the Founders Week schedule for the community birthday party, then observe the Granddaughters Club-led cake cutting.
cards.short_summary: A College birthday party and cake cutting closes the Founders Week Convocation.
cards.evidence_claim: Spelman states that its community birthday party and cake cutting are led by the Granddaughters Club following Convocation.
cards.access_notes: Part of the College’s annual Founders Week programming; confirm the current schedule.

cards.title: Attend the History and Traditions Convocation
cards.subtitle: Founders Week, Spelman College
cards.notes: Use the annual Founders Week listing to locate this program and learn how Spelman frames its institutional legacy.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated Convocation is part of Spelman’s Founders Week program.
cards.evidence_claim: Spelman’s Founders Week page lists the History and Traditions Convocation among the week’s activities.
cards.access_notes: Annual programming; check Spelman’s event page for the current date and access details.

cards.title: Recognize alumnae during Founders Week
cards.subtitle: Friendship Baptist Church, Atlanta
cards.notes: Consult the Founders Week calendar for the Alumnae Celebration and follow host-venue guidance for attendance.
cards.short_summary: Founders Week includes a named celebration for Spelman alumnae.
cards.evidence_claim: Spelman lists an Alumnae Celebration at Friendship Baptist Church as part of its Founders Week activities.
cards.access_notes: Event timing and venue instructions vary by year; confirm through Spelman’s schedule.

cards.title: Witness the March Through the Alumnae Arch
cards.subtitle: Spelman College Oval
cards.notes: After Class Day, observe the scheduled procession; eligible alumnae should follow the College’s attire and movement rules.
cards.short_summary: Alumnae precede seniors through the arch as seniors transition to alumnae.
cards.evidence_claim: Spelman says the Senior Class passes through the Alumnae Arch to symbolize graduation and greater service, with alumnae preceding them.
cards.access_notes: The March follows Class Day; only alumnae may walk through the arch, subject to College guidelines.

cards.title: Listen to graduating seniors’ reflections
cards.subtitle: Sisters Chapel, Spelman College
cards.notes: Watch for the Senior Expression Series schedule and attend or stream the students’ messages as announced by the College.
cards.short_summary: Selected graduating seniors share sermons and reflections with the Spelman community.
cards.evidence_claim: Spelman describes the Senior Expression Series as a tradition in which graduating students reflect on faith journeys and share messages with the community.
cards.source_title: Graduating Seniors Share Their Faith, Growth and Reflections | Spelman College
cards.access_notes: Schedule and participation are determined by Spelman and the Dean of the Chapel.

cards.title: Close the senior year with Baccalaureate
cards.subtitle: The day before Commencement
cards.notes: Graduates and guests should use the current commencement schedule for venue, streaming, ticketing, and arrival instructions.
cards.short_summary: Baccalaureate is Spelman’s final spiritual ceremony before Commencement.
cards.evidence_claim: Spelman identifies Baccalaureate as the final spiritual experience for students and a ceremony for the graduating class to reflect before Commencement.
cards.access_notes: Open to graduates, families, and community subject to the current commencement plan.
